detail.longDescription: I recently learned about Dexfile ( https:// github.com/ctryard/dexfile ), a superset of Dockerfile, which allows access to more of buildkit's underlying complexity (eg more expressive conditional behavior). This is going to help a lot on a project for work. It's cool because there's nothing to install -- you just add essentially a shebang line to the top of your Dockerfile and change the extension. # docker # containers
